name: Diantz.exe
description: Binary that package existing files into a cabinet (.cab) file
author: Tamir Yehuda

commands.description: Compress a file (first argument) into a CAB file stored in the Alternate Data Stream (ADS) of the target file.
commands.usecase: Hide data compressed into an Alternate Data Stream.
commands.os: Windows XP, Windows vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1.

commands.description: Download and compress a remote file and store it in a CAB file on local machine.
commands.usecase: Download and compress into a cab file.
commands.os: Windows Server 2012, Windows Server 2012R2, Windows Server 2016, Windows Server 2019

commands.description: Execute diantz directives as defined in the specified Diamond Definition File (.ddf); see resources for the format specification.
commands.os: Windows Server 2012, Windows Server 2012R2, Windows Server 2016, Windows Server 2019

detection: diantz storing data into alternate data streams.
diantz getting a file from a remote machine or the internet.
